subject.title: `infer model run` leaves a persistent session + transcript on every invocation (unbounded growth)

question: Should Gateway `infer model run` sessions be ephemeral or hidden from normal session lists by default, or is visible pressure-gated model-run session history the intended product behavior?
rationale: Current main deliberately keeps below-cap probe sessions after a recent merged cleanup policy, while this issue asks to remove or hide every one-shot probe session; that is a session lifecycle/product contract choice rather than a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Make Probes Ephemeral Or Hidden
options.body: Change Gateway model runs so they do not create client-visible durable sessions by default, while keeping cleanup for rows already created by older releases.

options.title: Keep Visible Probe History
options.body: Treat pressure-gated 24h cleanup as the intended contract and document that recurring probes may remain visible until cap pressure or manual cleanup.

options.title: Add A Filter Or Opt-Out First
options.body: Keep persistence but add a supported `sessions.list` filter or explicit one-shot opt-out surface after approving the new public API.

recommendation.title: Make Probes Ephemeral Or Hidden
recommendation.body: Change Gateway model runs so they do not create client-visible durable sessions by default, while keeping cleanup for rows already created by older releases.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently accepted and merged the related pressure-gated model-run cleanup policy, making them the clearest routing candidate for the remaining lifecycle decision.
